name: MossAI

sources.title: Homepage — '3000+ curated AI tools', categories from writing to code, active listings
Submit page — free submission requires linking back to mossai.org first; login required; manual review

conditions: Free submission requires adding a link to MossAI Tools on your website first — 'The submitted website must link to our website (Step 1 of the submission process)'
requirements: Practical, user-friendly product with an informative website, designed for end-users/consumers
Not related to cryptocurrency — explicitly disqualifying
Reciprocal link: the submitted site must link to mossai.org
Login required before submitting ('We need to verify your identity to ensure the authenticity of the submission')
Manual review — 'Submitting a tool does not guarantee publication'
preparation: A link/badge to https://mossai.org already live on your site (title 'MossAI Tools')
Tool name, URL, description emphasizing practical features and end-user benefits
An account on mossai.org for the submission login
workflow: Add a link to https://mossai.org (anchor 'MossAI Tools') on your website
Fill the submission form with the tool's details
Wait for manual review — approved tools are published to the directory
watchFor: Reciprocal-link gate is enforced at review — missing backlink = disapproval
Review tips say to highlight practical features and avoid hype
Directory carries 'Friends' link exchanges and DR-score marketing — typical low-mid tier AI directory
countsAsLive: The tool appears as an entry/detail page in the MossAI directory under its category after manual approval
unknowns: Whether the listing link is dofollow (likely, given the reciprocal-link requirement)
What login providers are supported (sign-in wall blocks inspection)
